title: Maximum distance time
description: Essential: Correctly identifies that the distance is greatest when the speeds are equal, leading to t = 5 s.

title: First catch-up time
description: Essential: Correctly solves for the first meeting time by equating displacements, yielding t = 10 s.

title: Second meeting total time
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the total time from start to the second meeting as 19.2 s.

title: Acceleration phase analysis
description: Important: Correctly calculates displacements and times for car A's acceleration to 24 m/s and car B's corresponding uniform motion.

title: Deceleration phase analysis
description: Important: Correctly calculates displacements and times for car A's deceleration to a stop and car B's corresponding uniform motion.

title: Gap calculation before final catch-up
description: Important: Correctly determines the distance between the cars when A stops, setting up the final uniform motion catch-up.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign (e.g., positive) for the braking acceleration during the deceleration phase.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (m, s, m/s²) throughout all kinematic calculations.
